name: Giridih
registryAssessment: The official Giridih district land-records page establishes a local government service context and links to Jharkhand's JharBhoomi land-record route. Official NIC Bhu-Naksha implementation material links Jharkhand's cadastral viewer. Direct anonymous access to the Jharkhand viewer hosts timed out before a current map/API response could be inspected, so local parcel geometry and a usable native identity were not independently evidenced; registryFound remains null.

queries.query: Giridih cadastral map parcel land records official Jharkhand
queries.result: Found the official District Giridih land-records page, the official Jharkhand GIS gateway, the official NIC Bhu-Naksha implementation directory, and the official DILRMP district computerization status page. The district page links JharBhoomi; the implementation directory links Jharkhand's Bhu-Naksha viewer.

queries.query: गिरिडीह जिला झारखंड आधिकारिक भू नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख प्लॉट मानचित्र
queries.result: Found official Jharkhand/Giridih land-record and Bhu-Naksha service routes in the Hindi-language discovery context. The accessible official pages establish the government service route but did not expose a safe parcel identity, schema, CRS, or parcel geometry.

officialSources.role: District Giridih, Government of Jharkhand official land-records service page
officialSources.observation: The page loaded over HTTPS and links citizens to the JharBhoomi land-record service; it identifies the District Revenue Office in Giridih. It does not provide parcel-vector geometry or a safe parcel identity in the page response.
The directory loaded and lists Jharkhand with the public viewer route https://jharbhunaksha.jharkhand.gov.in/. It is an implementation directory, not a parcel feature response.

officialSources.role: Department of Land Resources official district computerization report
officialSources.observation: The report lists Giridih district and computerization indicators, including the linked-cadastral-map status fields. It does not expose parcel geometries or a city query endpoint.

officialSources.role: Jharkhand Space Applications Center official GIS gateway
officialSources.observation: The gateway advertises state and district GIS applications, including district-specific portals. No Giridih parcel layer response was obtained in the bounded direct requests.

geometryDecision.reason: No bounded anonymous response containing a safe native parcel identifier and full polygon was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. Viewer connection timeout is not evidence of citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Giridih district official land-record service and Jharkhand Bhu-Naksha/GIS public routes.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service existence and viewer linkage were verified; current viewer JavaScript/configuration, API schema, CRS, native identity, exact-point containment, and citywide open parcel coverage were not verified.
